3912897.steps:
1.Bound to X0, add a static DHCP scope and a dynamic DHCP scope
2.In a client behind X0, make sure it is in dynamic DHCP scope
3.disable dynamic DHCP scope, from the client send DHCP INFORM to X0
4.do packet capture at the same time, check DHCP ACK
3912897.title: Verify DHCP INFORM will not be replied when there is no valid DHCP scope
3912897.result: Firewall will not respond to the inform packet when the DHCP scope is static, and not respond when the scope is disabled

3830207.steps:
1.Configure the firewall in the factory default settings.
2.Configure WAN
3.Do packet capture for ICMP,UDP for an IP address 1.1.1.1, 1.0.0.1 and 169.254.0.1
4.In 10-15 min, check firewall interface IP generating traffic to the above IPs.
3830207.title: Verify no unwanted DNS traffic can be captured
3830207.result: No suck unwanted traffic can be captured
